# SDD Agent core 0.2

SDD Agent now has a revision-bound core for document CRUD, cross-document
regression, separate API judge review and explicit human acceptance. The core
stays inside this project component and installs/tests independently. A matching
Architect-Agent-Framework remains an optional, explicit integration boundary.

## Start

```sh
python -m pip install -e '.[test]'
python -m sdd_core doctor examples/core-payments
python -m sdd_core check examples/core-payments --full
python -m sdd_core regression examples/core-payments --full
python -m pytest tests/core -q
```

The starter's deterministic check passes; initial readiness is INCOMPLETE until
semantic evidence and human decisions are supplied. It ships no approval or API
credential. This release verifies spec coherence, not code/runtime behavior.

Read [the usage guide](docs/CORE_WORKFLOW.md), [shared workflow](_shared-master/workflow-v2.md)
and [implementation ADR](docs/adr/0008-sdd-core-revision-bound-workflow.md).

## Components

| Path | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `sdd_core/` | Canonical schemas/parser, snapshots, typed graph, predicates/history, candidates, evidence, decisions, transaction/recovery |
| `sdd_core/adapters/` | Jev typed multi-document review, optional configured OpenAI-compatible judge and explicit parent-framework boundary |
| `sdd_core/evaluation.py` | Held-out evaluation, targeted scoring, uncertainty and provider qualification |
| `sdd_core/freshness.py`, `reporting.py` | External observations, due/unknown/ABA invalidation, owner/debt/coverage report |
| Three numbered skill folders | Thin author/reviewer instructions; v2 `workflow-contract.yml` |
| `_shared-master/workflow-v2.md` | One source of shared lifecycle policy; portable copies generated by build |
| `tools/` | Skill build, examples/corpus, rule inventory and release evidence tools |
| `tests/core/`, `tests/evals/core-corpus.json` | Offline invariant/transport/property/fault tests and proposed-label semantic seed |
| `scripts/`, hooks and manifests | Current core adapters; retired phase and ledger implementations are removed |

The host/skills call core; core calls judge APIs through adapters. No skill imports
another skill's scripts or edits the engine ledger. Parent calls are explicit.

## Release boundaries

Local POSIX filesystem and Markdown/YAML/JSON/text specs are supported. Native
Windows/NFS/distributed writers, arbitrary binary/HTML specs, custom generators
and code evidence are uncertified/unsupported. Use WSL's Linux filesystem on Windows.

The parent framework uses this core through explicit adapters. Retired phase, ledger, promoted judge and global skeleton implementations have been removed. Their provenance and current oracle ports are recorded in the parent source completion report.

Real semantic quality needs a configured model/budget/credential and independently
adjudicated held-out labels. The supplied seed is provisional, too small for
qualification. Synthetic/API transport fixtures are not live semantic evidence.
Default workflow stays advisory; enforce requires a qualified live report.

The wheel and source distribution contain the independent core only. The full
release ZIP additionally contains skills, current adapters, tests, docs,
evidence and a Git bundle. Build portable skills with `tools/build_skills.py`.

Source and evidence are versioned together. See [release verification](docs/RELEASE_VERIFICATION.md), `evidence/` and the release report
for the actual checks, C01-C80 coverage limits and cutover blockers.
